mapper.update: update trade_order set order_status = 4, cancel_type = 2, cancel_reason = '支付超时', cancel_time = current_timestamp, update_time = current_timestamp, version = version + 1 where id = #{orderId} and item_id = #{itemId} and order_status = 0 and expire_time <= current_timestamp
